quote: Where the signal is a steady yellow signal alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal is thereby warned that the related green movement is being terminated or that a steady red indication will be exhibited immediately thereafter, and such vehicular traffic must not enter the intersection when the red signal is exhibited.

activation.condition: Vehicular traffic faces a steady yellow signal alone on its governed route.

obligation.description: Warning of related green termination or immediately following red; no entry when red is exhibited.

exceptions.disposition: companion indication changes applicability; original readback required

timing.description: Original selected route signal state at surveyed body entry.

judgment_calls_needed.note: 20 Hz front/polygon bracket is evidence, not a legal boundary.
Observed phase delay is not a statutory numeric cutoff.

parameter_refs.name: entry_phase
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: green, steady yellow or red source observation

parameter_refs.name: ego_behavior
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: traverse or stop before surveyed entry
